blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The judges of a trial chamber at the International Criminal Court have found that former President Rodrigo Duterte would be able to stand trial effectively after his overall health appeared to have improved since his arrest. The latest ruling on the health of Duterte cleared the path for him to fully participate and attend in person his trial for crimes against humanity, which is set to begin on Nov. 30. Trial Chamber (TC) III said in its 17–page decision on Sept. 28, but released on Thursday night, that a three-member panel of experts that examined Duterte’s health found […]...
